message: task pr-ready writes pr-ready.json after the task's final commit and immediately opens the PR, but no allowed commit/push step exists afterward; gh pr create does not include dirty files, so the marker can never land on origin/main as AC2 requires, while committing it inside the command would make payload commit==HEAD self-referential or stale.

notes: Correct catch. Resolution: (1) the marker payload's commit field = the SEALED task commit C = HEAD captured BEFORE the marker is written (the reviewed product commit), NOT HEAD-after-the-marker-commit — so it is neither self-referential nor stale. (2) Ordered flow of forge task pr-ready: capture C=current HEAD; run require_task_sealed on C (it checks PRODUCT cleanliness via product_tree_snapshot, so an uncommitted .factory marker does not trip it); write the marker (recorder-style .factory write the command performs); COMMIT it as an evidence-only commit M (no product delta); git push the branch; gh pr create. (3) The marker rides in M on the branch and lands on origin/main when the PR merges — that is AC2's advance signal (task 8's cat-file gate reads it). The task-4 stage-local stamp stays valid because the marker is .factory, excluded from product_tree_digest. So drop 'commit==HEAD'; use sealed_commit=C plus a real marker commit+push. Committing/pushing the marker IS allowed here (the command owns that evidence commit).

message: PostToolUse ledger contract is missing the authoritative AskUserQuestion hook payload/result shape (including chosen values versus free-text notes) and generated_by values required by schema validation; implementation cannot proceed without guessing.

notes: Hook input (both PreToolUse and PostToolUse) is JSON on stdin with session_id, transcript_path, cwd, hook_event_name, permission_mode, tool_name, tool_input and, on PostToolUse, tool_response. For AskUserQuestion tool_input is {questions:[{question, header, multiSelect, options:[{label, description}]}]}. tool_response is not documented locally: treat it defensively — if it is an object with an 'answers' mapping of question text to a label string (or list of labels when multiSelect), set chosen to that; if the mapping carries a dict with a 'label' key use the label; in every other case chosen is null. Never persist 'annotations', 'notes', 'description' or any other free text — only question, option labels, chosen. The live check after stage done confirms the real shape; the fallback (chosen null, question-text provenance) is accepted per the plan. generated_by: use 'claude-code:plan-mode' for BOTH record kinds and make it the only value in each new schema's generated_by allowlist; the hook writes it as a constant, not from the payload. permission_mode plan-mode value: compare against the string 'plan'. session_id may be absent: store '' then. Record file names are uuid4 hex like events.py.

message: Approved task plan requires absolute path plus raw sha256 and sha256_body, and AskUserQuestion at/session with nullable chosen; delegated brief/reviewer requires sha256 itself use plan_digest_without_assumptions and names only the smaller round shape. Need one authoritative record contract before implementation can complete.

notes: Authoritative record contract (supersedes any earlier wording): PLAN-MODE MARKER = {path: absolute path as written (may be outside the repo, e.g. ~/.claude/plans/x.md), sha256: hex of the raw file bytes, sha256_body: plan_digest_without_assumptions(path), at: UTC ISO, session_id: string ('' when absent), generated_by: 'claude-code:plan-mode'}; schema required keys exactly those six; recorded for Write/Edit/MultiEdit when permission_mode == 'plan' and the file exists after the write. GRILL ROUND = {questions: [{question: str, options: [label str...], chosen: str|null}], at: UTC ISO, session_id: string ('' when absent), generated_by: 'claude-code:plan-mode'}; chosen comes from tool_response.answers[question] when it is a string in options (or a list of labels when multiSelect), else null; the record is written whenever tool_input.questions is a non-empty list of {question:str, options:list} — missing tool_response never suppresses it; no notes/annotations/description persisted. Both schemas' generated_by allowlist = ['claude-code:plan-mode']. Records land via evidence_path under the active story's plan-mode/ and grill-rounds/ dirs, or root-level when no story is active. Fail-open everywhere: any exception -> exit 0, nothing written.
